entities.name: Nemanjić dynasty
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The House of Nemanjić was the most prominent native Serbian dynasty of Serbia in the Middle Ages. This princely, royal and imperial house produced twelve Serbian monarchs, who ruled between 1166 and 1371.
